steps.message:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Kenpoly-sec-school-field, Bori Metropolis. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1874 | 2.78 | 2.78
2 | 2428 | 9.13 | 11.9
3 | 1071 | 15.2 | 27.1
4 | 3706 | 32.2 | 59.3
5 | 178 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as KHK-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Kenpoly-sec-school-field, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Report – Kenpoly-sec-school-field, Bori Metropolis**

The resistivity sounding reveals a five-layer subsurface sequence. Layer 1 (1874 Ω·m, 2.78 m thick) is underlain by a more resistive Layer 2 (2428 Ω·m, to 11.9 m depth), followed by a lower-resistivity Layer 3 (1071 Ω·m, to 27.1 m). Layer 4 shows a marked resistivity increase (3706 Ω·m, to 59.3 m depth), and the sequence terminates in a conductive basal Layer 5 (178 Ω·m).

Applying the curve-type convention to the resistivity sequence (1874, 2428, 1071, 3706, 178):
- Layers 1-2-3: rise then fall → K
- Layers 2-3-4: fall then rise → H
- Layers 3-4-5: rise then fall → K

This yields a KHK-type curve, consistent with the classification on file. No discrepancy was found between the tabulated resistivity values and the stated curve type.
